standard-dialogue.npc: The tithes are growing weak. That werewolf needs to do a better job of keeping them fed.
There's no shortage of corpses around here. The dead can still have some uses.

standard-dialogue.player: You're feeding them corpses? No wonder they're becoming weak. That meat must have all sorts of problems.

standard-dialogue.npc: What else would you have me feed them? If I give them nicer food, I'm wasting more money than if I were to just kill them and buy some more.

standard-dialogue-if-the-player-is-not-d.npc: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
